svg.title: Agent-Ready — conceptual diagram
svg.desc: repository contract for ai agents. Conceptual technical diagram, not a screenshot. One schema-validated file that tells every AI coding agent how to work in a repository — the commands, the restrictions, the verification steps, and the evidence that the work is done.
